title: Sosis
summary: Raleigh names Sosis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sosis, in the list of old Aegyptian Kings which Cedrenus deliuers, who followed Sol the sonne of Vulcan. The length of his raigne is not set downe. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, §. V, sig. 358b
